propositions: Cumulative counter streams in observability.sh persist offset files before CloudWatch accepts the put-metric-data request, causing transient AWS failures to permanently lose the failed interval's count.

Seven metric streams across six code shapes (replication, voter, merge-change, deploy, shared helpers, and G2P) advance their offsets prematurely, making the next run compute zero deltas instead of retrying the accumulated count.
Runtime experiments confirmed that forcing AWS calls to fail leaves offsets at the advanced position; subsequent successful runs publish zero rather than the accumulated delta.
Offset advancement must be moved inside the successful AWS branch so failures leave offsets unchanged and allow the next run to retry the accumulated delta.
The script must preserve exit-zero behavior and existing logging on AWS failure while ensuring only successful publications advance the acknowledgement offset.
